item.title: Sensible Chuckle
item.description:
To tell you the truth i think satire might be dead, satire isnt a comedic discipline anymore its simply the state in which we exist.
Gotta be honest, as an outsider, hes far less scary than most of y'all. He also has a beautifully proportioned head.
My minds going two paths on this one, Homeland, and Transplant. Hes not disproving any "harmful" stereotypes from Transplant, hes smoking hot.
Oh how i wish this was satire...
Interesting thing about that name, the direct translation is "The lord" or "The leader". Sayed and it's various other spellings are names of great honour, typically reserved for those believed to descend directly from the prophet. The legendary Spanish knight El-Cid obviously wasnt a descendant of the prophet but he was gifted the name by the moorish troops he led into battle during his 10 year exile which he spent serving the muslim rulers of Zaragoza. Pity they picked that wanker Heston to play him.
